project.purpose: Decompose confirmed website Human/Agent authority and effect-replay responsibilities, with explicit canary scope and cross-Security consumer contracts. No new Web runtime or registry.

nodes.label: WebAuthnPrincipalAndChallenge
nodes.responsibility: Bind one account/Principal to an authenticated WebAuthn credential/challenge lifecycle by delegating protocol verification to SimpleWebAuthn.
nodes.authority: Web product/session/effect state only; Security/provider cryptographic and policy truth remain external
inputs: principal/enrollment context; one-shot challenge and credential records
outputs: authenticated Principal identity and consumed challenge or denial
nodes.behavioralContract: Challenge consumption is one-shot; credential and challenge are persisted to the Owner-local store; browser/virtual authenticator proof is not a claim of physical human presence.
acceptance: Owner session/challenge tests verify one-shot behavior and browser E2E evidence scopes without treating canary enrollment as production-ready.
mustNotOwn: Security Agent OAuth/DPoP verification or Agent admission policy
production IAM enrollment or deployment acceptance
formalObligations: Refinement gap: real external authenticator/canary enrollment/production recovery and installed TLS context remain UNKNOWN.

nodes.label: BrowserSessionAndMutationAdmission
nodes.responsibility: Admit human browser state mutations only under an authenticated opaque session plus CSRF, exact Origin and Fetch-Metadata checks.
nodes.authority: Web product/session/effect state only; Security/provider cryptographic and policy truth remain external
inputs: opaque browser session cookie; server-stored hash, session expiry/revocation state
outputs: Principal session projection; admitted authenticated mutation or typed denial
nodes.behavioralContract: Session token is not an authority-bearing credential beyond its exact server-bound identity; unsafe browser mutations require same-site and CSRF guards; session idle/absolute expiry, revocation and audit operate independently of Agent DPoP flow.
acceptance: Native web tests verify hashed session tokens, absent-origin/CSRF denial, idle expiration and session revocation.
mustNotOwn: Security Agent OAuth/DPoP verification or Agent admission policy
production IAM enrollment or deployment acceptance
formalObligations: A local test-only SQLite-backed session is not evidence of production reliability, or an argument to retain SQLite in long-term persistent architecture.

nodes.label: AgentGrantIssueAndRevocation
nodes.responsibility: Manage Principal-owned delegated Agent Grants, scope, revocation and remaining-effect budgets without inventing OAuth/DPoP verifier or Security policy.
nodes.authority: Web product/session/effect state only; Security/provider cryptographic and policy truth remain external
inputs: WebAuthn-authenticated Principal authorization and grant request
Agent identity, audience, actions, risk and resource scope
outputs: versioned Grant record; revocation and remaining-quota state with consumer-visible standing
nodes.behavioralContract: Issued Grants and revocations bind one Principal/Agent/scope and remain source-owned; revoked Grants block future effects without invalidating already committed historical exact replay.
acceptance: Owner Agent authority tests cover Grant revocation and future-effect denial distinct from historical committed receipts.
mustNotOwn: Security Agent OAuth/DPoP verification or Agent admission policy
production IAM enrollment or deployment acceptance
formalObligations: No generalization from canary Grant scope to live provider IAM or production issuance recovery.

nodes.label: SecurityOwnedAgentAdmissionAdapter
nodes.responsibility: Consume exact Web-local Grant/effect context and delegate Agent request verification plus Agent/Effect Admission to existing Security-owned contracts; produce scoped decision without owning Security cryptography, Rego or executable effects.
nodes.authority: Web product/session/effect state only; Security/provider cryptographic and policy truth remain external
inputs: Agent method/origin and OAuth/DPoP evidence; Web-local replay guard
typed exact Grant, effect, risk and optional approval inputs
outputs: typed VerifiedAgent plus Security admission-chain decision or fail-closed rejection
nodes.behavioralContract: If Security verifier is absent or returns an invalid decision, admission fails closed. OAuth/DPoP verification and policy are consumed from Security-owned contracts; Web retains only local DPoP replay state and request-to-policy input binding.
acceptance: Existing Web tests exercise missing Security verifier rejection and Security verifier boundary; real installation qualification remains UNKNOWN.
mustNotOwn: Security Agent OAuth/DPoP verification or Agent admission policy
production IAM enrollment or deployment acceptance
formalObligations: Cross-Owner psi=>phi and deployed DPoP proof currentness UNKNOWN; Web does not mint Security policy authority.

nodes.label: EffectBoundStepUpAndReplay
nodes.responsibility: Commit exactly scoped canary create/publish mutations under independently admitted Grant/Agent/Effect policy and effect-bound WebAuthn step-up while preserving exact historical replay.
inputs: exact effect digest and receipt identity
R4 effect-specific WebAuthn step-up approval when required
outputs: new committed canary receipt, identical historical replay, or explicit conflict/deny
nodes.behavioralContract: R2 create commits under admitted scope; R4 publish requires step-up approval bound to the exact effect and consumes it once; identical replay preserves previous receipt and conflicting payloads or fresh revoked-grant effects reject.
acceptance: Native Web tests cover exact replay/conflict, R4 approval and revoked Grant historical replay.
Local canary write != external provider effect, no installed/exactly-once distributed claim.
formalObligations: Source/transaction behavior does not prove installed WebStore durability, physical provider effects or cross-provider exactly-once.
nodes.authority: Web canary identity/grant/receipt source only, not external provider or Security truth
mustNotOwn: production publication or installed provider effect

nodes.label: HumanAndAgentHttpAssembly
nodes.responsibility: Compose browser sessions and Agent admission/effects into one Fastify HTTP application while preserving separate authentication and permission rails.
inputs: browser cookies, CSRF/Origin and WebAuthn requests
outputs: HTTP routes and response/error mapping for authenticated browser and Agent operations
nodes.behavioralContract: Browser mutations use opaque session plus same-Origin/CSRF, while Agent mutations use Security-owned DPoP/Grant/admission rather than browser cookie or CSRF; a missing verifier does not admit Agent effects.
acceptance: Owner source bootstrap calls createWebApp; native browser and agent tests exercise HTTP route boundaries.
SOURCE/virtual browser evidence is not public production deployment readiness.
formalObligations: Cross-owner installed Security/Browser/PG state qualifications UNKNOWN.
nodes.authority: Web canary identity/grant/receipt source only, not external provider or Security truth
mustNotOwn: production publication or installed provider effect
